data.title: Minami.ai - AI Platform
data.description: Frontend development for Minami.ai, a modern, high-performance, and responsive web application built with Astro leveraging its island architecture for optimized loading times. Implemented responsive, mobile-first layouts with Tailwind CSS for utility-first design and maintainable code. Integrated Headless UI for fully accessible, customizable components. Focused on SEO optimization, accessibility standards including keyboard navigation and screen readers, ensuring consistent experience across devices.

data.title: Descript - Web Application
data.description: Fast, responsive web application built for Descript using Next.js framework. Integrated Builder.io for dynamic content management and utilized Emotion for styling. Deployed and optimized with Nginx for performance and reliability. Showcases modern frontend development practices, headless CMS integration, and production-ready web applications.

data.title: Qalorie - Weight Loss Health App
data.description: Comprehensive weight loss health app built with React Native, Redux, Hooks, and Saga. Developed backend with Node.js and MongoDB, integrated AWS S3 for media storage. Implemented social authentication (Facebook, Apple, Google, Email) with Firebase, video & voice calls with CometChat platform, live chat, push notifications, Google Analytics, and AppsFlyer. Built social media features including multiple image/video posting, comments, likes, and user following. Integrated payment gateways (PayPal, Stripe) and published on AppStore and PlayStore.

data.title: Food Network Kitchen - Recipe App
data.description: Mobile app development for Food Network Kitchen featuring React Native, Redux, and TypeScript. Integrated third-party APIs for food recipes and ingredients, implemented push notifications with Firebase Cloud Messaging. Added multi-language support and payment gateway integration with Stripe and PayPal. Delivered smooth user experience with comprehensive recipe management features.

data.title: Roadstar Truck Repair - WordPress Website
data.description: Responsive WordPress website for truck repair business designed and developed with Elementor. Features include service pages, online appointment booking, contact forms, and Google Maps integration. Optimized for speed, SEO, and mobile devices to ensure a professional online presence.

data.title: HelloBible - Spiritual Companion App
data.description: Mobile app development for HelloBible, a spiritual companion experience featuring AI chatbot integration with LLM backend for contextual Bible Q&A, daily reflections, and personalized spiritual guidance. Built cross-platform with React Native, developed chat interface with smooth conversational flow and real-time streaming responses. Integrated push notifications and Firebase for authentication and user profiles. Optimized for offline storage and responsive UI/UX.

data.title: Going Solo - Travel Social App
data.description: iOS development for a social app connecting solo travelers. Built core modules including Nearby page (travelers, groups, hangouts), Trips (create/join/manage travel plans), Matching (premium buddy finder), Feed (country pages, posts, journals), and Chat (real-time messaging). Implemented with Swift/SwiftUI and UIKit, integrated Firebase for authentication and real-time sync, optimized caching for offline usage, and implemented push notifications.

data.title: Gamdom - Online Casino Platform
data.description: Frontend development for a leading online casino platform with a clean, modern dark-themed interface. Built reusable UI components supporting multiple games (Crash, Dice, Slots) with full responsive design for desktop and mobile. Focused on performance, scalability, and smooth gaming experience using MERN stack and Material UI.

data.title: E-Commerce Platform
data.description: Full-stack e-commerce solution with React frontend, Node.js backend, and MongoDB database. Features include payment integration, inventory management, and admin dashboard.

data.title: HaxMediaPartners - Portfolio Website
data.description: A comprehensive informational portfolio website for HaxMediaPartners, featuring custom logo design, website design, and full development. The project started with creative design work including logo creation and website mockups, then evolved into full WordPress development with custom themes and responsive design.
